seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 11369 adds two level V items to EO 11248: (15) Administrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, and (16) Chief, Children's Bureau, SRS (both HEW). EO 11409 item 2 (April 29, 1968) deletes item (15) and inserts the Deputy Administrator, HSMHA; the SRS Administrator moves to level IV under EO 11409's own item 1(a). EO 11409 (Apr. 29, 1968) deletes item (16) and inserts the Counselor to the Department. Neither acting order states another effective date. The latest clause end, and so the whole-order end, is 1968-04-29; the 1973 revocation by EO 11708 is a post-end formal event. The OFR catalog lists no disposition for EO 11369. A transfer of the Children's Bureau within HEW would not by itself abolish the placed position, and no held source records an earlier abolition. Family method: the researcher read the saved official Federal Register OCR text layers (heading to FR Doc line) of this order, of EO 11248 and of all 40 orders that the OFR disposition notes and the 1989 Codification list as amending it, plus EO 11708, 11715, 11736 and 11768, and traced every item of EO 11248 sections 1 and 2 through each addition, deletion, word substitution and renumbering. EO 11708 sec. 3 (signed and filed March 23, 1973; no other effective date) revokes EO 11248 as amended, except for the eight positions listed in its section 2; none of them is a position whose placement this order's text still supplied. Where a later amender deletes an item and inserts another in its place, the earlier item's placement ends on that amender's effective date; the series' separate 'substituting for the words' formula is treated as a retitling that continues the item. Pure deletions, renumberings and effective-date provisions are one-time edits completed when the order took effect. The 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 amendment notes for 1964-1973 record no statutory placement of the positions concerned. Abolition of a position by unpublished departmental action is outside the held sources and is a limitation of this bounded search. Page images were not viewed; quotations are exact from the saved OCR, including its recognition errors. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: The order only placed, removed or renumbered positions in pay levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule under 5 U.S.C. 5317 (formerly sec. 303(f) of the 1964 Salary Reform Act). Removal of a placement operates prospectively; pay already received is a completed historical consequence, and no entitlement, transfer of functions or right is preserved. Neither the acting order nor EO 11708 contains a savings or incumbent-protection clause for this order's items. The only carve-out, EO 11708 sec. 3's exception for the positions listed in its sec. 2, does not cover them; EO 11768's incumbent clause (1974) concerns its own list.
